candidates.description: This vector represents common German grammatical words, conjunctions, and auxiliary verbs used for connecting clauses and indicating case.
This feature vector represents common German action verbs in various conjugated forms.
This vector represents round-bottomed vessels and containers used for holding things.
These tokens represent German modal and auxiliary verbs expressing necessity, possibility, or conditional states.
This vector represents the concept of variety, difference, or distinctness across multiple languages.
This vector is related to indefinite articles and cardinal numbers in German and English, particularly forms of "a" and "one."
This feature vector activates on German subordinating conjunctions and relative pronouns that introduce dependent clauses.
This vector represents common German verbs in various inflected forms.
This vector activates strongly for German words and word fragments related to the root "spiel" (play/game).
This vector represents German possessive and demonstrative determiners and pronouns inflected across various cases, genders, and numbers.
